<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Laughing Yellow Blob — Animated</title>
<style>
  html, body { margin: 0; padding: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; background: #fafafa; }
  canvas { display: block; width: 100vw; height: 100vh; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { RoundedBoxGeometry } from 'three/addons/geometries/RoundedBoxGeometry.js';

// ---------- renderer / scene / camera ----------
const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ preserveDrawingBuffer: true, antialias: true });
renderer.setPixelRatio(1);
renderer.setSize(216, 216, false);
renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;
renderer.shadowMap.type = THREE.PCFSoftShadowMap;
renderer.toneMapping = THREE.NoToneMapping;
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

const scene = new THREE.Scene();
scene.background = new THREE.Color(0xf7f7f7);

const ref = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(32, 1, 0.1, 50);
ref.position.set(0, 1.72, 6.0);
ref.lookAt(0, 1.55, 0);

// ---------- lights ----------
const hemi = new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xffffff, 0xe8e2d8, 0.95);
scene.add(hemi);

const key = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 1.35);
key.position.set(2.5, 5, 5);
key.castShadow = true;
key.shadow.mapSize.set(1024, 1024);
key.shadow.camera.left = -3; key.shadow.camera.right = 3;
key.shadow.camera.top = 4; key.shadow.camera.bottom = -1;
key.shadow.camera.near = 1; key.shadow.camera.far = 15;
key.shadow.bias = -0.002;
scene.add(key);

const fill = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xfff4e0, 0.45);
fill.position.set(-4, 1.5, 3);
scene.add(fill);

const rim = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 0.55);
rim.position.set(0, 3.5, -5);
scene.add(rim);

// ---------- floor (soft contact shadow) ----------
const floor = new THREE.Mesh(
  new THREE.PlaneGeometry(30, 30),
  new THREE.ShadowMaterial({ opacity: 0.10 })
);
floor.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
floor.position.y = 0;
floor.receiveShadow = true;
floor.name = 'floor';
scene.add(floor);

// ---------- materials ----------
const matYellow = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xf3c31d, roughness: 0.85, metalness: 0.0 });
const matBelly  = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xf2d9ac, roughness: 0.9, metalness: 0.0 });
const matDark   = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x241408, roughness: 0.9 });
const matMouth  = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x1c0d06, roughness: 0.95 });
const matTeeth  = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xffffff, roughness: 0.55 });
const matTongue = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xa83226, roughness: 0.8 });
const matHand   = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x4a4a4a, roughness: 0.9 });

function shadowed(mesh) { mesh.castShadow = true; mesh.receiveShadow = true; return mesh; }

// ---------- character ----------
const character = new THREE.Group();
character.name = 'character-yellow';
scene.add(character);

// torso: everything above the hips, pivot low so squash/lean keeps feet planted
const PIVOT_Y = 0.55;
const torso = new THREE.Group();
torso.name = 'torso';
torso.position.set(0, PIVOT_Y, 0);
character.add(torso);

// body: pear-shaped lathe blob
const profile = [
  [0.001, 0.45], [0.50, 0.50], [0.80, 0.65], [0.98, 0.90],
  [1.05, 1.20], [1.03, 1.50], [0.95, 1.75], [0.82, 1.95],
  [0.78, 2.15], [0.78, 2.40], [0.72, 2.65], [0.58, 2.85],
  [0.35, 3.00], [0.001, 3.08]
].map(p => new THREE.Vector2(p[0], p[1]));
const bodyGeo = new THREE.LatheGeometry(profile, 48);
bodyGeo.scale(1, 1, 0.92);
const body = shadowed(new THREE.Mesh(bodyGeo, matYellow));
body.name = 'body';
body.position.set(0, -PIVOT_Y, 0);
torso.add(body);

// belly patch
const belly = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 32, 24), matBelly);
belly.name = 'belly';
belly.scale.set(0.60, 0.52, 0.34);
belly.position.set(0, 1.18 - PIVOT_Y, 0.72);
belly.castShadow = true;
torso.add(belly);

// ---------- head group (face features; pivot at neck) ----------
const head = new THREE.Group();
head.name = 'head';
head.position.set(0, 2.10 - PIVOT_Y, 0);
torso.add(head);

// closed laughing eyes (dark arcs)
function makeEye(side) {
  const g = new THREE.Group();
  g.name = side < 0 ? 'eye-left' : 'eye-right';
  const arc = Math.PI * 0.9;
  const torus = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.10, 0.030, 10, 24, arc), matDark);
  torus.rotation.z = (Math.PI - arc) / 2;
  torus.castShadow = true;
  g.add(torus);
  g.position.set(side * 0.27, 0.63, 0.60);
  g.rotation.y = side * 0.38;
  g.rotation.z = side * -0.12;
  return g;
}
const eyeL = makeEye(-1), eyeR = makeEye(1);
head.add(eyeL); head.add(eyeR);

// ---------- mouth group ----------
const mouth = new THREE.Group();
mouth.name = 'mouth';
mouth.position.set(0, 0.26, 0.70);
head.add(mouth);

// dark open cavity
const cavity = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 32, 24), matMouth);
cavity.name = 'mouth-cavity';
cavity.scale.set(0.36, 0.31, 0.20);
mouth.add(cavity);

// tongue
const tongue = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 24, 16), matTongue);
tongue.name = 'tongue';
tongue.scale.set(0.18, 0.07, 0.10);
tongue.position.set(0, -0.15, 0.04);
mouth.add(tongue);

// teeth rows following the mouth curvature
function teethRow(name, count, y, rx, rz, w, h, d, span) {
  const row = new THREE.Group();
  row.name = name;
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const t = count === 1 ? 0 : (i / (count - 1)) * 2 - 1;
    const a = t * span;
    const tooth = new THREE.Mesh(new RoundedBoxGeometry(w, h, d, 2, 0.02), matTeeth);
    tooth.position.set(Math.sin(a) * rx, y, Math.cos(a) * rz);
    tooth.rotation.y = a;
    tooth.castShadow = true;
    row.add(tooth);
  }
  return row;
}
mouth.add(teethRow('teeth-upper', 6, 0.205, 0.295, 0.165, 0.105, 0.145, 0.07, 0.95));
mouth.add(teethRow('teeth-lower', 5, -0.235, 0.26, 0.150, 0.10, 0.10, 0.06, 0.85));

// ---------- arms ----------
const hands = [];
function makeArm(side) {
  const arm = new THREE.Group();
  arm.name = side < 0 ? 'arm-left' : 'arm-right';
  arm.position.set(side * 0.82, 1.85 - PIVOT_Y, 0.08);

  const curve = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3([
    new THREE.Vector3(0, 0.05, 0),
    new THREE.Vector3(side * 0.15, -0.65, 0.10),
    new THREE.Vector3(side * -0.16, -1.30, 0.30)
  ]);
  const tube = shadowed(new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TubeGeometry(curve, 24, 0.15, 12), matYellow));
  tube.name = 'arm-mesh';
  arm.add(tube);

  // hand (dark gray, fingers down resting near knee)
  const hand = new THREE.Group();
  hand.name = side < 0 ? 'hand-left' : 'hand-right';
  hand.position.set(side * -0.16, -1.30, 0.30);
  hand.rotation.x = 0.35;
  arm.add(hand);
  hands.push(hand);

  const palm = shadowed(new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 20, 14), matHand));
  palm.name = 'palm';
  palm.scale.set(0.095, 0.08, 0.06);
  hand.add(palm);

  const fingers = new THREE.Group();
  fingers.name = 'fingers';
  hand.add(fingers);
  const offsets = [-0.062, -0.021, 0.021, 0.062];
  for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
    const f = shadowed(new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(0.030, 0.12, 4, 10), matHand));
    f.name = 'finger-' + i;
    f.position.set(offsets[i], -0.115, 0.01);
    f.rotation.z = offsets[i] * -1.6;
    f.rotation.x = 0.15;
    fingers.add(f);
  }
  const thumb = shadowed(new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(0.028, 0.09, 4, 10), matHand));
  thumb.name = 'thumb';
  thumb.position.set(side * -0.10, -0.04, 0.03);
  thumb.rotation.z = side * 0.9;
  fingers.add(thumb);

  return arm;
}
const armL = makeArm(-1), armR = makeArm(1);
torso.add(armL); torso.add(armR);

// ---------- legs & feet ----------
const feet = [];
function makeLeg(side) {
  const leg = new THREE.Group();
  leg.name = side < 0 ? 'leg-left' : 'leg-right';
  leg.position.set(side * 0.38, 0.45, 0);

  const thigh = shadowed(new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(0.22, 0.28, 6, 14), matYellow));
  thigh.name = 'leg-mesh';
  thigh.position.set(0, -0.18, 0);
  leg.add(thigh);

  const foot = shadowed(new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 20, 14), matYellow));
  foot.name = 'foot';
  foot.scale.set(0.24, 0.11, 0.31);
  foot.position.set(0, -0.37, 0.07);
  leg.add(foot);
  feet.push(foot);
  return leg;
}
const legL = makeLeg(-1), legR = makeLeg(1);
character.add(legL); character.add(legR);

// ---------- animation ----------
// Laugh cycle: upright with head thrown back  <->  doubled-over crouch.
// Keyframes sampled from the GIF (loop = 1220 ms).
// fields: [time ms, crouch 0..1, head pitch (rad, rel. torso), mouth scale, body twist (rad)]
const LOOP = 1220;
const K = [
  [   0, 0.00, -0.70, 1.00,  0.00],
  [ 180, 0.85, -0.10, 0.96,  0.05],
  [ 340, 0.00, -0.95, 1.06,  0.00],
  [ 520, 0.75, -0.15, 0.95,  0.10],
  [ 680, 1.00, -0.05, 1.00,  0.06],
  [ 860, 0.00, -0.80, 1.00, -0.04],
  [1020, 0.80, -0.10, 0.96,  0.08],
  [1200, 1.00,  0.00, 1.00,  0.05]
];

function sample(t) {
  t = ((t % LOOP) + LOOP) % LOOP;
  let i = K.length - 1;
  for (let j = 0; j < K.length; j++) {
    const nt = j < K.length - 1 ? K[j + 1][0] : LOOP;
    if (t >= K[j][0] && t < nt) { i = j; break; }
  }
  const a = K[i], b = K[(i + 1) % K.length];
  const at = a[0], bt = (i === K.length - 1) ? LOOP : b[0];
  const u = (t - at) / (bt - at);
  const e = 0.5 - 0.5 * Math.cos(Math.PI * u); // smooth ease, exact at keys
  return {
    crouch: a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * e,
    head:   a[2] + (b[2] - a[2]) * e,
    mouth:  a[3] + (b[3] - a[3]) * e,
    twist:  a[4] + (b[4] - a[4]) * e,
    phase:  2 * Math.PI * t / LOOP
  };
}

function render(t) {
  const p = sample(t);
  const c = p.crouch;

  // squash & stretch + forward lean about the low torso pivot (feet stay planted)
  torso.scale.set(0.98 + 0.12 * c, 1.04 - 0.22 * c, 0.98 + 0.12 * c);
  torso.rotation.x = -0.05 + 0.50 * c;

  // head: thrown back when upright, level/forward when doubled over
  head.rotation.x = p.head;
  head.rotation.z = p.twist * 0.5;
  character.rotation.y = p.twist;

  // laughing mouth pulsation (periodic over the loop, zero at t=0)
  const m = p.mouth * (1 + 0.03 * Math.sin(6 * p.phase));
  mouth.scale.set(m, m, m);

  // eyes squint harder in the deep crouch
  const sq = 1 - 0.12 * c;
  eyeL.scale.set(1, sq, 1);
  eyeR.scale.set(1, sq, 1);

  // arms: hang at sides when upright, swing forward/inward onto knees when crouched
  const ax = 0.12 - 0.62 * c;
  const az = 0.05 + 0.20 * c;
  armL.rotation.set(ax, 0,  az);
  armR.rotation.set(ax, 0, -az);
  hands[0].rotation.x = 0.35 + 0.45 * c;
  hands[1].rotation.x = 0.35 + 0.45 * c;

  // knees bend forward in the crouch, feet counter-rotate to stay flat
  legL.rotation.x = -0.35 * c;
  legR.rotation.x = -0.35 * c;
  feet[0].rotation.x = 0.35 * c;
  feet[1].rotation.x = 0.35 * c;

  renderer.render(scene, ref);
}

window.nwb = {
  scene,
  renderer,
  cameras: { ref },
  characters: [character],
  render,
  ready: true
};

render(0);
</script>
</body>
</html>
